modules.name: Business model canvas & unit economics
modules.why: One page: who pays, for what, how much margin per unit.
watch: margin by brand differs: contractor vs system licensor vs exporter
scenarios: Raise material cost 8% and keep price: what is the new margin per m2?

modules.name: Assumptions master (prices, costs, FX, tax rates)
modules.why: Single source of truth; every other file reads from it.
watch: tax rates change yearly: store source and date next to each rate
Label every price and cost as VAT-inclusive or VAT-exclusive
Keep a change log: who changed which rate, when, why
scenarios: Change the VAT rate cell: which sheets move?

modules.name: Sales policy: channels, commission, discount
modules.why: Commission and discount are real costs that shrink margin.
watch: commission paid to individuals is taxable income (check withholding)
scenarios: Discount 5% more to win a bid: how many extra projects needed to recover margin?

modules.name: Fixed-cost budget & monthly overhead
modules.why: Fixed cost decides break-even and the cash you need each month.
watch: fixed cost must be covered even in months with no sales
Employer insurance and union fee (about 23.5% of insured salary) belong in fixed cost
Spread yearly costs (audit, licences, insurance premiums) monthly so no month surprises you
scenarios: No sales for 2 months: how much cash is burned?

modules.name: Sales forecast & scenarios (best / base / worst)
modules.why: Plans must survive a bad quarter.
watch: revenue timing vs cash timing
scenarios: Win rate falls from 30% to 20%: which month does cash go negative?

modules.name: Break-even & pricing per m2 / per set
modules.why: Know the minimum price that still pays all costs.
watch: price quoted below full cost looks like a sale but loses money
A price below full cost looks like a sale but is paid for later by a cash shortage
Include warranty reserve and finance cost in the minimum price
scenarios: Fixed cost doubles: how many m2 per month to break even?

modules.name: Quotation / BOQ costing per m2
modules.why: Build the price from real quantities: profile kg, glass m2, hardware, labour, install, overhead, margin.
watch: waste/cutting loss must be in the cost
VAT shown separately on quotes
Set a quote validity period: aluminium and euro prices move
Show VAT separately (10%, or the reduced rate only if the item qualifies - verify)
Add contingency for installation risk and site delays
scenarios: Aluminium price +10%: what is the quote increase to hold margin?

modules.name: Project job costing & P&L per project
modules.why: Shows which projects make money after ALL costs (not just materials).
watch: cost overruns found late; allocate shared factory cost fairly
Allocate shared factory and site costs by a written rule
Book cost to the project when incurred, not when paid
Hold a warranty reserve per project
scenarios: Project delayed 2 months: how much extra site cost and finance cost?

modules.name: Billing schedule & milestone payments
modules.why: Advance, progress and acceptance payments decide your cash, not the contract total.
watch: issue the invoice at the right time (invoice timing penalties exist from Jan 2026)
Issue the invoice at the milestone or acceptance date: wrong timing is penalised from 16 Jan 2026
(verify) VAT timing on advance payments
Cash arrives by milestone, so forecast cash from this schedule, not from contract value
scenarios: Client pays 30 days late: what happens to cash in the month and to profit?

modules.name: Retention / warranty holdback & release tracker
modules.why: Part of the contract is held until warranty ends; it is profit you have not collected yet.
watch: (verify) terms are contract-specific; record per contract
scenarios: Retention is 5% on 20 projects: how much cash is locked for 12 months?

modules.name: Receivable aging & collection
modules.why: Late customers are the #1 reason profitable contractors run out of cash.
watch: bad-debt provisions: tax deductibility needs documents (verify rules)
Chase before 30 days overdue, escalate at 60, stop work at 90 (set your own rule)
(verify) bad-debt provision is deductible only with required legal documents
Retention is not overdue until its release date
scenarios: A 90+ day invoice of 500m: what is the cash and profit impact if written off?

modules.name: Subcontractor & installation crew payments
modules.why: Crew payments are large, often cash, and need documents.
watch: (verify) withholding when paying individuals; non-cash payment rules for large invoices
scenarios: Crew rate +10%: effect on project margin?

modules.name: Bid bond & performance guarantee tracker
modules.why: Guarantees tie up cash or credit lines and cost fees.
watch: expired guarantee not returned = money stuck
scenarios: 5 bids at once need bonds: how much credit line is used?

modules.name: WIP & revenue recognition
modules.why: Decides when profit is booked: by % complete or at handover. Accounting vs tax may differ.
watch: (verify) tax timing of revenue vs accounting timing
scenarios: Estimated cost rises 10% mid-project: how does booked profit change?

modules.name: Warranty provision & after-sales cost
modules.why: Warranty claims are a future cost caused by today's sales.
watch: (verify) provision deductibility conditions
scenarios: Claim rate doubles: what reserve do you need?

modules.name: Contract risk register
modules.why: Penalty clauses, delay damages, price escalation, scope change.
watch: unrecoverable aluminium price rises if contract has no escalation clause
scenarios: Aluminium +15% after signing and no escalation clause: loss per project?

modules.name: Material price tracker (aluminium, glass, hardware)
modules.why: Aluminium and EUR prices move; quotes go stale.
watch: price validity of quotes; FX on EUR hardware
scenarios: Price rises 6% next month: which open quotes lose margin?

modules.name: Purchase orders & supplier payables
modules.why: Know what you owe and when; protect early-payment discounts and supplier relations.
watch: VAT input deduction needs valid invoice and payment evidence (verify thresholds)
Match purchase order, delivery note and invoice before paying
Supplier invoice must be a valid e-invoice in the company name for VAT deduction
Compare early-payment discount with the cost of the cash
scenarios: Suppliers shorten terms from 45 to 30 days: cash effect?

modules.name: Inventory & stock count
modules.why: Stock is cash sitting on shelves; count differences are losses.
watch: stock loss deductibility needs documents (verify)
scenarios: Slow stock of 300m for 6 months: carrying cost?

modules.name: Cutting yield, scrap & recovery
modules.why: Profile cutting loss is a real cost; scrap sale is income with VAT rules.
watch: VAT treatment of scrap/by-products was clarified from 1 Jan 2026
scenarios: Yield drops 3 points: cost per m2?

modules.name: Factory overhead & product costing
modules.why: Electricity, rent, supervisors, machine time must be allocated to products.
watch: under-allocated overhead makes quotes too cheap
scenarios: Factory utilisation falls 20%: cost per unit?

modules.name: Fixed assets & depreciation register
modules.why: Machines and vehicles: depreciation is deductible only within rules.
watch: (verify) depreciation limits for vehicles; minimum asset value; useful-life ranges
scenarios: Buy a new CNC machine of 1.5bn: monthly depreciation and cash impact?

modules.name: Imported hardware landed cost (@SUP@, EUR)
modules.why: True cost = price + freight + insurance + import duty + import VAT + customs fees + FX.
watch: import VAT is cash out before sales; duty classification (HS code); FX loss
(verify) import duty depends on HS code and origin: confirm the rate for aluminium-system hardware from Italy
Import VAT paid at customs is deductible only with complete documents
Customs exchange rate vs bank rate: the difference is an FX cost
Freight, insurance and broker fees belong in landed cost
scenarios: EUR rises 4% against VND: effect on unit cost and price list?

modules.name: Capacity vs fixed-cost absorption
modules.why: Idle capacity is cost without revenue.
watch: do not accept low-margin jobs just to fill capacity without checking contribution
scenarios: Utilisation 60% vs 85%: unit cost difference?

modules.name: Export order costing & margin per container
modules.why: Margin in USD after freight, insurance, packing, duties and FX.
watch: Incoterms decide who pays freight/duty; margin must be per container
Incoterms (FOB / CIF / DDP) decide who pays freight, insurance and duty
Margin must include packing, container loading, bank charges and rebates
Costs are in VND/EUR but revenue is in USD/CAD/AUD: show the FX effect
scenarios: Freight rises 25%: is a CIF order still profitable?

modules.name: FX exposure & gains/losses
modules.why: You sell in USD/CAD/AUD, cost in VND/EUR: FX moves profit.
watch: realised vs unrealised FX; year-end revaluation (verify tax treatment)
Record the rate at invoice date, payment date and year-end (revaluation)
Show FX gain/loss separately from operating profit
Match USD costs with USD revenue where possible (natural hedge)
scenarios: VND strengthens 3%: effect on USD receivables?

modules.name: Export VAT 0% & VAT refund tracker
modules.why: Exports are 0% VAT; input VAT can be refunded but needs complete documents and time.
watch: refund conditions and documents changed in 2025-2026; cash is stuck until refund
(verify) 0% VAT needs: sales contract, commercial invoice, customs declaration and bank payment proof
Late or missing documents mean the input VAT stays as a cost
The supplier of your materials must have declared VAT on its invoices for you to be refunded
Refund can take months: show locked cash in the cash-flow file
scenarios: Refund takes 6 months instead of 2: how much cash is locked?

modules.name: Customs & export document checklist
modules.why: Missing or inconsistent documents block shipment, refund and payment.
watch: document names/numbers must match across set
scenarios: Packing list weight differs from invoice: what documents break?

modules.name: Destination tariffs & trade remedies tracker
modules.why: Buyer-country duties can wipe out your price advantage.
watch: (verify) US additional tariffs; AD/CVD case outcomes; Canada/Australia/Cambodia rules
scenarios: US adds 10% duty: new price needed to keep margin?

modules.name: Foreign buyer credit risk, deposits & L/C
modules.why: Foreign customers can pay late or not at all, and recovery is hard.
watch: use deposits, L/C or credit insurance for new buyers
scenarios: A buyer with 200k USD overdue 90 days: provision and cash?

modules.name: Distributor / agent commission & rebate
modules.why: Retail channel (e.g. home-improvement chains) demands rebates, returns allowances.
watch: rebates reduce net revenue; record them accurately
scenarios: Chain asks 3% rebate: net margin?

modules.name: Intercompany transactions & reconciliation
modules.why: @B1@ buys from @B3@; @B3@ may sell to @B2@. Both sides must match.
watch: unmatched intercompany balances = errors and audit questions
Same price, date and amount in both companies' books
Month-end cut-off: delivered vs invoiced
(verify) VAT invoice is required even between related companies
scenarios: @B3@ invoices 1bn but @B1@ recorded 900m: where is the gap?

modules.name: Transfer pricing & related-party disclosure
modules.why: Related companies must trade at arm's-length prices and disclose.
watch: (verify) disclosure forms and thresholds; owner-controlled entities are related parties
scenarios: @B3@ sells to @B1@ at a 5% discount versus others: any tax risk?

modules.name: Consolidated group view & owner dashboard
modules.why: Owner needs one view across 3 entities with intercompany removed.
watch: do not double count intercompany revenue
scenarios: Remove intercompany: what is real group revenue?

modules.name: Licence/royalty & foreign-payment tax
modules.why: Payments to foreign parties (royalty, licence, services) may trigger foreign contractor tax and treaty questions.
watch: (verify) foreign contractor tax on payments to the Italian group and DTA relief documents
scenarios: Pay 20k EUR licence fee: what tax is due on top?

modules.name: VAT: input / output & invoice matching
modules.why: Monthly or quarterly VAT: output minus deductible input; every input invoice must be valid.
watch: valid invoice + payment evidence; temporary rate reduction through end of 2026 for eligible items (verify eligibility)
Reconcile the VAT return to the ledger every period
(verify) invoices from risky suppliers can lose the deduction
Input VAT on non-business use is not deductible
scenarios: Supplier invoice issued but not declared by supplier: effect on your deduction?

modules.name: CIT: quarterly provisional & annual finalisation
modules.why: Corporate income tax from 2025: tiered rates by revenue (conditions apply).
watch: (verify) which rate your entity qualifies for; provisional payment accuracy; loss carry-forward
Check which revenue tier applies (based on prior-year revenue)
Add back fines, personal expenses, costs without valid invoices; (verify) limits on interest and depreciation
(verify) provisional payments must be close to the final tax to avoid late interest
scenarios: Revenue crosses 50bn: how much extra CIT next year?

modules.name: Non-deductible expense & document audit
modules.why: Expenses without valid documents are added back to taxable income.
watch: (verify) non-cash payment threshold; invoices in company name; personal expenses
Invoices must be in the company name and match the payment
Review recurring risky items: entertainment, gifts, personal fuel
(verify) non-cash payment threshold for large invoices
scenarios: 200m of expenses without invoices: extra CIT?

modules.name: PIT withholding & annual finalisation
modules.why: Employee salary tax with new 2026 deductions and brackets; also commissions and crews.
watch: new brackets and deductions apply to the 2026 tax year
Withhold on every pay run and finalise yearly
(verify) withholding on commissions and crew paid as individuals depends on contract type
Dependents must be registered before the deduction applies
scenarios: Employee with 2 dependents earns 30m/month: PIT before and after the new law?

modules.name: E-invoice compliance register
modules.why: Wrong timing, cancelled and adjusted invoices cause penalties.
watch: invoice timing penalties updated from 16 Jan 2026
scenarios: Invoice issued after delivery month: what is the risk?

modules.name: Tax calendar & deadline tracker
modules.why: Missing a deadline costs penalties and interest.
watch: monthly/quarterly VAT, quarterly CIT, PIT, insurance, annual finalisations
Set each date from the tax authority calendar (verify current dates)
A missed deadline means penalty and late-payment interest
Name an owner and a backup for every filing
scenarios: Which filings fall in the same week next month?

modules.name: Tax losses, incentives & funds
modules.why: SME rates, new-company exemptions, science & technology fund, loss carry-forward.
watch: (verify) eligibility conditions; fund can be set aside up to 20% of taxable income under the new CIT law
scenarios: A loss year followed by profit: tax saved from carry-forward?

modules.name: Tax inspection readiness file
modules.why: A prepared folder cuts inspection stress and penalty risk.
watch: keep evidence for VAT, CIT, PIT, transfer pricing
scenarios: Which 10 documents would you need first in an inspection?

modules.name: Other taxes & fees
modules.why: Licence fee, import duty, foreign contractor tax, land/property, environment fees.
watch: business licence fee exemption from 2026 (verify scope); others to verify
scenarios: Which fees apply to the factory site?

modules.name: Payroll with 3P / KPI
modules.why: Pay for Position, Person, Performance; ties salary to results.
watch: variable pay still counts for tax and insurance depending on how it is structured (verify base for insurance)
Structure matters: variable pay may or may not count for insurance (verify)
Cap KPI payouts to protect cash
Write the KPI formula into the policy or contract
scenarios: Sales KPI 80% vs 100%: pay and company cost difference?

modules.name: Insurance & union fee calculator with caps
modules.why: Employer pays about 23.5% on top of salary in 2026 (within caps); employee pays 10.5%.
watch: caps changed on 1 Jul 2026; minimum wage changes 1 Jan 2027
Employer pays about 23.5% and employee 10.5%, within caps
Caps changed on 1 Jul 2026 (base salary 2.53m): update every employee
Unemployment cap uses the regional minimum wage, not the base salary
scenarios: Hire 5 workers at 12m/month: total monthly employer cost?

modules.name: Bonus, commission & bid-win payout
modules.why: Technical bid-win bonuses and sales commissions are taxable pay and real cost.
watch: include in PIT; decide whether part counts for insurance (verify)
Bonus is taxable income for the employee
(verify) whether the bonus counts for insurance depends on how it is structured
Cap the pool as a % of project gross profit and pay after cash is collected
scenarios: Win a 5bn bid: bonus cost and net to the employee?

modules.name: Overtime, night shift & factory pay
modules.why: Overtime premiums have special tax treatment; hours must be recorded.
watch: (verify) exempt portion of overtime premium for PIT
scenarios: Peak season +30 OT hours per worker: cost?

modules.name: 13th-month / Tet bonus, severance & unused leave
modules.why: Year-end payouts need cash planning; unused-leave pay is now exempt from PIT.
watch: unused annual-leave payment exempt from PIT under the new law
scenarios: Tet bonus 1 month: how much cash must be saved by December?

modules.name: Headcount plan & cost per head
modules.why: Total cost per employee, not just salary.
watch: each new hire adds 23.5% employer cost on insured pay
scenarios: Add 3 sales staff: break-even revenue needed?

modules.name: Labour contract & regional minimum wage check
modules.why: Salaries must not fall below regional minimums; they rose in Jan 2026 and again in Jan 2027.
watch: check every salary against the minimum each year
scenarios: Minimum wage +7% in 2027: which employees fall below?

modules.name: Cash-flow: 13-week and 12-month
modules.why: Profit is not cash: timing of collection and payment decides survival.
watch: tax payments, insurance, bonuses, import VAT are lumpy cash outflows
Include tax, insurance and bonus payment dates
Include import VAT outflows and VAT refund inflows
Show a minimum cash buffer in every week
scenarios: Which week is the lowest cash? What funding fills it?

modules.name: Working capital & credit line utilisation
modules.why: Receivables + inventory - payables = cash locked in operations.
watch: bank covenants and guarantee limits
Credit limit vs guarantees already issued
Check bank covenants, if any
Watch the gap between receivable days and payable days
scenarios: Customers pay 20 days later: how much extra credit is used?

modules.name: Loan & interest schedule
modules.why: Loan interest is deductible only within limits.
watch: (verify) interest deductibility cap under current decrees
scenarios: Rate +2%: monthly interest and profit?

modules.name: Owner payouts: salary, dividends, shareholder loans
modules.why: How the owner takes money out changes tax and cash.
watch: (verify) PIT on dividends; shareholder loan interest and documentation
(verify) salary, dividend and shareholder loan are taxed differently
A shareholder loan needs a written agreement
Do not pay the owner's personal expenses from the company
scenarios: Take 1bn as salary vs dividend vs loan: tax and cash difference?

modules.name: Profit-sharing / partnership agreement calculator
modules.why: Capital, effort, profit split between partners written down before starting.
watch: write the exit and loss rules before the first sale
scenarios: Project loses 200m: who bears how much?

modules.name: Equity & capital contribution register
modules.why: Who contributed what and when; needed for legal and tax records.
watch: legal registration of changes (verify)
scenarios: Add a new partner at 20%: dilution?

modules.name: Personal finance & investment tracker (owner)
modules.why: Keep personal and company money separate; track net worth and investments.
watch: do not mix personal and company payments
scenarios: Market falls 20%: effect on net worth?

modules.name: Monthly management report pack
modules.why: One workbook the director reads each month: P&L, cash, receivables, backlog by brand.
watch: compare to budget and last year
Use the same definitions every month
Reconcile to bank and ledger before reporting
Show every large variance with its reason
scenarios: What changed most versus last month and why?

modules.name: Budget vs actual variance
modules.why: Explains differences, not just shows them.
watch: flag variances over a set threshold
scenarios: Materials 12% over budget: price or quantity?

modules.name: KPI dashboard by department
modules.why: Sales, technical, site, factory, procurement, HR, accounting KPIs.
watch: few KPIs per department
scenarios: Which department missed its KPI and what did it cost?

modules.name: Approval limits & internal control checklist
modules.why: Who may approve what amount; separation between ordering, receiving and paying.
watch: fraud and error risk is highest in cash payments and returns
scenarios: One person orders, receives and pays: what can go wrong?

modules.name: Month-end & year-end closing checklist
modules.why: A fixed routine prevents missing accruals and cut-off errors.
watch: cut-off of revenue and costs
scenarios: A December invoice booked in January: what changes?

modules.name: Document retention & file naming
modules.why: Retention rules and consistent names make audits and searches fast.
watch: (verify) legal retention periods
scenarios: Can you find the 2024 contract with client X in 1 minute?
